title: RunCapacityModel
description: capacity_model.json: everything the planner needs from one run, so servtuner plan never reads raw data. Per-stage curves are per replica: the run's achieved RPS over its ready replicas.

ready_replicas.description: Replicas of the workload under test during the usable stages; 0 when unknown, and then the curves cannot be scaled.

scale_out.description: Replica counts the model was measured at. Linear scale-out is verified only by runs at two or more counts with per-replica RPS within 10%.

tokenCost.description: Token cost of the requests at the SLO-max stage, from the bundled datasheet and the router's own cost counter. Absent when token_pricing is none. An unpriced model is is_priced false with a reason, never free.

datasheet_key.description: The datasheet entry that priced it.

datasheet_fetched_at.description: When servtuner run fetched the datasheet that priced it (pricing/token.json): the prices are as of then.

datasheet_source.description: Where that datasheet came from: pricing/token.json's url_basis (price_book is the operator's).

method.description: router_metric: the router's own cost counter (Bifrost bifrost_cost_total, LiteLLM litellm_spend_metric_total), authoritative; datasheet: servtuner's own tokens × base prices; manual: servtuner's own tokens × the RunSpec's manual prices.

datasheet_usd_per_1k_requests.description: servtuner's calculation, kept as the cross-check when the router's metric is used.

divergence.description: |router − datasheet| ÷ router, when both exist; over 0.05 is reported.

retry_added_usd_per_1k_requests.description: Router cost minus the cost of the client's successful requests: what retries and fallbacks added (rules B4 and L3).

approximations.description: What the calculation does not model.

infraCost.description: Infrastructure cost of one replica at the recommended sizing, from pricing/infra.json. Absent when the run's infra_pricing source is none; is_priced false, with a reason, when the source has no price for this hardware.

method.description: gpu: the replica pays for the GPUs it holds (node price ÷ node GPUs, or the GPU model's price). node_share: it pays for the larger of its share of the node's allocatable cores and memory.

basis.description: The calculation with its values, for display.

usd_per_1k_requests.description: A replica's hour over the requests it serves in an hour at its SLO-max RPS, per thousand (the infra_cost_per_1k_requests objective).

usd_per_1m_output_tokens.description: The same per million output tokens, from the SLO-max stage's output token rate per replica.

unit_cost_reason.description: Why a priced replica has no cost per request or per output token (no SLO-max, no replica count, no output token rate).

modelIdentity.description: What the model is valid for: a plan inherits this scope (Guard rails 3).

knobs.description: Knob values captured from the target.

workload_hash.description: SHA-256 of the RunSpec's workload block as canonical JSON, without its seed: runs with the same hash measured the same request mix.

workload_preset.description: The workload preset the run named, when it named one.

latencyPoint.description: A latency percentile of one stage, seconds; absent when the stage had too few samples for it.

is_usable.description: Valid and not excluded: only usable stages may be interpolated between.

modelPerReplica.description: The recommended resources of one replica at the operating point (recommendations.json), summed over the workload's containers.

modelQueueing.description: The operating stage's queueing inputs, for re-sizing C and B at a planned load.

modelMemory.description: The router's working set against requests in flight per replica, WS = baseline + m × L, with the request size it was measured at.

stages.description: Usable stages the line was fitted through.

request_bytes_mean.description: Mean request body size over the usable stages; absent when the engine reported none.

queue_size.description: The recommended B for the router, held in memory beside C.

limit_headroom.description: The sizing policy's limit headroom h_lim, applied to the working set before it is compared with the memory limit.
